headline: This Weekend
in Three Village
dek: It's Halloween weekend: trick-or-treating through Stony Brook Village and Port Jeff on Saturday, the fire department's Monster Dash, the last farmers market of the season on Friday and a Mischief Market on Sunday. Clocks fall back an hour Sunday morning. Here's everything worth doing in Three Village this weekend, updated live.

hero.credit: Halloween Festival in Stony Brook Village. Photo: Ward Melville Heritage Organization
hero.alt: Families in costume on the lawn at the Halloween Festival in Stony Brook Village

reboli.name: The Reboli Center for Art and History

events.title: Three Village Farmers & Artisans Market
events.desc: The last market of the season: farmers, bakers and makers on the historical society lawn, 3 to 6 PM. Free to walk in and browse.

events.title: Haunted Evening Hayrides at Benner's Farm
events.desc: A tractor ride through the dark woods at Benner's Farm. The first hour is a Not-So-Spooky ride for younger friends; later rides get scarier. Tickets are sold online only and every rider needs one, kids included.

events.title: Be Our Ghost at Theatre Three
events.desc: A Third Act cabaret night of songs from some of the most devious villains of film, TV and the stage. Shows at 6:30 and 9 PM.

events.title: Po' Boy Brewery Halloween Costume Party
events.desc: Their costume party: everyone's welcome, costumes get happy hour prices all night, plus a food truck, music and gift cards for the top 3 costumes, voted by guests.

events.title: Stony Brook Fire Department 5K Monster Dash Race
events.desc: The fire department's 10th annual Monster Dash moves to Stony Brook Village this year: Fun Run at 9 AM, 5K at 9:30 AM. Costumes encouraged, with trick-or-treating in the village to follow.

events.title: Trick or Treating for Littles at the Reboli Center
events.desc: A kid-friendly Halloween day with seasonal crafts, spooky music and trick-or-treating at the information desk. Costumes encouraged, no RSVP needed.

events.title: Trick or Treat in Port Jefferson Village
events.credit: Photo: Greater Port Jefferson Chamber of Commerce
events.desc: Trick-or-treat around Port Jefferson Village from 11 AM to 5 PM, plus a fun scavenger hunt. Participating businesses have a sign in their window.

events.title: 36th Annual Halloween Festival in Stony Brook Village
events.desc: Trick-or-treat through the Stony Brook Village Center shops and eateries, games in the Inner Court, WALK FM's Walkie Bear from 1 to 3 PM, photos with Monster Merlin and the scarecrow winners announced at 2 PM.

events.title: Trick or Treat at the Haunted Museum
events.desc: Kids come in costume, trick-or-treat through the Jazz Loft's exhibits, visit the haunted garden and hear the New Orleans Goblins Jazz Band.

events.title: Night at the Museum: Halloween at the Jazz Loft
events.desc: Come in costume for a spooky cocktail in the haunted garden and music by the New Orleans Goblins Jazz Band.

events.title: Halloween Party at Tommy's Place
events.desc: Eat, drink and be scary: the party starts at 8 PM and the costume contest is at midnight. Arrive early to beat the line.

events.title: Autumn Concert with the Jazz Loft Trio
events.desc: The Jazz Loft Trio will perform a mix of classic jazz standards and Great American Songbook tunes, in the library's Vincent R. O'Leary Community Room.

events.title: All Saints Mischief Market
events.desc: An all-ages outdoor market with live music, food, vendors, a Spooky Walk trail, crafts, a costume contest and raffles for The SEED Foundation.

allweekend.title: Spooky Village at Olde Towne Gardens
allweekend.desc: A family Halloween village at the East Setauket garden center: Gourdvilla the Pumpkin Queen's Spooky Walk, a pumpkin slide, ghost bounce house, games and a pumpkin patch.
